description: This file contains utility functions for streaming and parsing server-sent events (SSE), streaming response bodies as text, and parsing newline-delimited JSON from HTTP responses.

methods.name: parseSseLine
methods.description: Parses a single line from an SSE stream, returning an object indicating if parsing is done and the data.

methods.name: streamResponse
methods.description: Streams a Response body as UTF-8 text chunks, handling cancellation and errors.

methods.name: streamSse
methods.description: Streams Server-Sent Events from a Response, parsing SSE format and yielding data objects.

methods.name: streamJSON
methods.description: Streams newline-delimited JSON from a Response, parsing each line as a JSON object.
